csv_scope_of_work: The County of Monterey Department of Public Works, Facilities and Parks (PWFP), hereinafter referred to as County , is soliciting qualification packages from a qualified organization(s), hereinafter referred to as CONTRACTOR(s) , to provide architectural and engineering design services for various County projects located in the County of Monterey, California. The scope of work shall include, in general, the full range of architectural and engineering design services including services of sub-consultants typically required for correctional facilities and other architectural projects in the public sector.

title: On-Call Architectural & Engineering Design Services
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary design services for county public-sector building and correctional facility projects.
project_location: Salinas, California, USA; various projects throughout Monterey County, California.
project_scope: Framework-style on-call design services for various county projects. Scope generally covers the full range of architectural and engineering design services, including subconsultants typically required for correctional facilities and other public-sector architectural projects. No specific building sizes, gross floor areas, structural spans, or individual project technical characteristics are stated.
services: On-call architectural and engineering design services, including architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, cost estimating, feasibility studies, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Base period 36 months with 24-month renewal option.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a general on-call framework for multiple unspecified county projects rather than a defined structural project.
- The notice focuses broadly on architectural and engineering services, with structural engineering only one discipline among many.
- Project types include correctional facilities and other public-sector buildings, which are generally not core sbp target projects.
- No information is given on large spans, special structures, innovative materials, sustainability ambitions, or architecturally demanding structures.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are explicitly low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for on-call design services covering multiple future county projects, so no realistic single construction cost estimate can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee, contract value, or estimated design budget is stated in the notice. Because this is an on-call multi-project solicitation with unspecified task orders, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualification packages are requested from qualified organizations able to provide the full range of architectural and engineering design services, including subconsultants typically required for correctional facilities and other public-sector architectural projects. No specific minimum number of references or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
